title: The token transfer processor credits the admin, not the recipient, of a legacy custom-token mint event

target.versions_affected: v0.9.0 and main 376279e8 (executed by hand; range not established)

severity_basis: processors/token_transfer/contract_events.go parses a legacy custom-token mint [mint, admin, to] under TransactionMeta v4 with the CAP-67 layout and credits topics[1] (the admin) instead of the recipient, so balances derived from the events are wrong for those tokens. Seen on real pubnet ledgers 64870500 and 64870521; the clawback branch has the same shape (not executed).

entries.expected: the mint credits the recipient named in the last topic
entries.observed: Not run by the kit against go-stellar-sdk: on this ledger, read from the public data lake with go-stellar-sdk v0.9.0 and main 376279e8, the token transfer processor credits the admin (topics[1]) instead of the recipient named in the last topic.

entries.expected: the mint credits the recipient named in the last topic
entries.observed: Not run by the kit against go-stellar-sdk: on this ledger, read from the public data lake with go-stellar-sdk v0.9.0 and main 376279e8, the token transfer processor credits the admin (topics[1]) instead of the recipient named in the last topic.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs: pubnet ledgers 64870500 (transaction 4f2d99a0…) and 64870521 (transaction 829d96b9…) from the public data lake through go-stellar-sdk v0.9.0 and main 376279e8; confirmed by reading processors/token_transfer/contract_events.go. No run of the kit drives the token transfer processor on these entries, so no report row exists.
evidence.expected_basis: A legacy (pre-CAP-67) mint event names the recipient in its last topic; the credit must go to the recipient (the operation's ledger meta credits it).

reproduction.method: Reproduced in a separate run on pubnet ledgers 64870500 (4f2d99a0…) and 64870521 (829d96b9…) from the public data lake with go-stellar-sdk v0.9.0 and main 376279e8: a legacy [mint, admin, to] event under TransactionMeta v4 is credited to the admin.

approval.scope: Public issue on stellar/go-stellar-sdk (#6044): legacy custom-token mint/clawback [mint, admin, to] credited to the admin under TxMeta v4.

history.note: Created from a triage of stellar-etl replay rows, confirmed by reading go-stellar-sdk v0.9.0 (equal to main).
Filed by the maintainers of this kit as https://github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/issues/6044 (v0.9.0 and main 376279e8; pubnet 64870500 and 64870521; related stellar-etl#467).
